cmd.mepservice.help: Hlola izinsiza, khetha eziqhubeka kuzo izinto ezintsha, noma engeza eyakho
cmd.mepscale.help: Setha isikali womdwebo osayizi wophawu nombhalo wethegi kubalwe ngaso
cmd.meppipe.help: Doba umugqa wephayipi esendaweni yawo yesevisi: umugqa owodwa noma imigqa emibili ngobubanzi bangaphandle bangempela
cmd.mepduct.help: Doba umugqa womoya: onxande ngobubanzi, ongqindilili ngodayamitha, noma ovumelekayo njengomugqa ogoqayo
cmd.mepsym.help: Beka ivalvu noma into eyengeziwe emugqeni: iwuqhekeza, ihambisane nawo futhi ithola ithegi
cmd.mepequip.help: Beka izisetshenziswa ocwebeni: iradiyetha, i-fan coil, iyunithi yokuphatha umoya, ibhoyila, i-chiller, ithangi, isishintshi sokushisa, izimbobo zomoya
cmd.meptag.help: Shintsha ithegi lophawu noma lezisetshenziswa, noma ubale wonke amathegi kabusha ngokulandelana kokufunda
cmd.mepsizetag.help: Bhala usayizi nesevisi yomugqa eduze kwawo
cmd.meplegend.help: Beka noma uvuselele inkomba yezinsiza, izimpawu nezisetshenziswa ezisemdwebeni
cmd.mepsched.help: Bala izimpawu nezisetshenziswa ngohlobo, usayizi nesevisi, bese ubeka noma uvuselele inani njengethebula
cmd.mepselect.help: Khetha yonke ingxenye yomugqa ocindezela kuwo
